screen.hibiscuslib.gallery.text.sample:
# Text layout
Wrapped text with **bold words**, &bcolour codes&r and a [link to Minecraft.net](https://www.minecraft.net), which asks before it opens.

## A list
- Bullets wrap under their own indent, so a long item lines up neatly with the start of its first line.
- &aGreen&r, &6gold&r and &cred&r codes work inside bullets.
- **Bold** works too.

## Another paragraph
A blank line starts a new paragraph. Quest descriptions, team pages and help screens all use this layout.
